change_log.summary: Initial general project prompt pack seed.
Added beginning-of-chat closure warning requiring LETS TAKE A BREAK or LETS STOP NOW to trigger governance/handoff closing workflow.

example_usage: Copy this prompt from Tab 9, replace adaptation variables, and present it to an AI as part of a selected prompt stack.
explainer: Routes the prompt stack for any project and tells the AI when to request special protocols.
how_it_works: It establishes load order, precedence, and safety rules before any implementation begins. It also tells the AI to show an early end-of-chat closure warning so the user knows to request governance update or handoff materials before stopping.
mitigations: Keep examples clearly marked and separate from active instructions.
The prompt requires an early warning telling the user to say LETS TAKE A BREAK or LETS STOP NOW to trigger safe closure workflow.
risks: Prompt may be used without replacing adaptation variables.
Project-specific examples may be mistaken for active project truth.
User may end a chat without creating a handoff or governance update request when needed.
